FLOW.STEP: 1. GameRoom constructor: CSPRNG(nanoid(32)) → SixPoolManager(playerCount,csprng) → createGrid(dim,settings,pool,Date.now()) → committedHash=SHA256(seed)
2. handleStartGame: broadcast committedHash to all players → energy tick starts → turn timer starts
3. EventStore: MATCH_START event written (seed_hash, classArchetype per player)
5. L4 wrappers applied in fixed order
6a. FARKLE: unbanked=0, farklePool+=unbanked_before, multiplierStep=0, comboBreaker window 250ms, phase=FARKLE_ANIM, nextTurn()
6b. SCORE(chain lt 6): scaledScore→unbanked, auto-bank, multiplierStep=0, gravity+spawn
6c. SCORE(chain=6): scaledScore→unbanked, multiplierStep++, timer restart, NO auto-bank
6. Seed reveal: broadcast raw serverSeed for player audit

FAIRNESS_CHAIN.STEP: serverSeed: 32-byte crypto.getRandomValues (generateServerSeed). 192-bit entropy. Set in GameRoom constructor.
committedHash = SHA-256(serverSeed). Stored as Promise before first roll.
handleStartGame: broadcast committedHash to all players. Pre-play commitment locked.
Play proceeds. All RNG from CSPRNG(combinedSeed) where combinedSeed=SHA256(serverSeed+clientSeeds).
SESSION_END: broadcast raw serverSeed. Players compute SHA-256(serverSeed) → compare to committedHash → verify match.
Player can re-derive entire CSPRNG sequence from combined seed → audit all dice rolls deterministically.
FAIRNESS_CHAIN.GAP: createGrid(seedNum=Date.now()): grid layout NOT covered by commit-reveal. Board arrangement not auditable.
clientSeeds[] collection mechanism not confirmed in read code — deriveCombinedSeed(serverSeed,clientSeeds[]) takes array but JOIN_ROOM handling not seen.
